headerDisplay: Exposes UniFi Access doors wired to garage openers as HomeKit garage doors, using the hub's door position sensor for real open/closed state.

host.title: Access Host
host.description: IP of the console running UniFi Access (the UNVR, not the gateway).

token.title: Access API Token
token.description: Created in UniFi Access under Settings > General > API Token. Not the same as a UniFi OS API key.

rejectUnauthorized.title: Verify TLS certificate
rejectUnauthorized.description: Leave off for a local console with a self-signed certificate.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to read door position. Lower is more responsive to manual operation.

travelSeconds.title: Default travel time (seconds)
travelSeconds.description: Fallback window if the position sensor never reports. Set comfortably above real travel time.

unlockMethod.title: Unlock HTTP method
unlockMethod.description: Change to POST if PUT returns HTTP 405.

testMode.title: Test mode (do not actually unlock)
testMode.description: Logs the request it would send without sending it. Use for first run to verify the endpoint.
